name: Crystal Beach
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Crystal Beach?
answer_short: Yes. On the Bolivar Peninsula, golf carts may use roads posted 35 mph or less and cross Highway 87 at intersections, but not drive along it.

rules.rule: Golf carts on roads posted 35 mph or less; not on highways, which they may cross
Golf cart rules for roads posted 35 mph or less

banned_roads.name: State Highway 87
banned_roads.rule: No golf carts; cross at intersections

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Crystal Beach?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on Highway 87?
faq.a: No. Golf carts may only cross SH 87 at intersections.

faq.q: Do I need a license to drive a golf cart in Crystal Beach?
faq.a: Yes. You need a valid driver's license, and night driving needs lights and reflectors.
